### A Door of Hope in the Valley of Trouble
Author: Jill Briscoe
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/one-year-devotions-for-women/a-door-of-hope-in-the-valley-of-trouble-one-year-devotions-for-women-february-21.html
Passage: 1 Chronicles 2:7
Points:
- Bad choices and secret disobedience often leave people feeling trapped in hardship.
- Achan brought disaster upon himself, his family, and Israel by greedily taking forbidden plunder.
- Sins kept in secret cannot remain hidden from God and will eventually harm others.
- Rather than ignoring or concealing failure, believers must bring their sins into the open before God.
- God graciously promises to turn our valley of trouble into an open doorway of hope and forgiveness.
